description: Agent Insurance: submit one policy’s claims conditions with an incident record: the policy with its occurrence or claims-made trigger as recorded, the dates it takes effect and expires, the retroactive date for a claims-made policy, the days from the incident by which notice must be given, the days by which proof of loss must be filed and whether they count from the incident or the notice, the extended reporting period or tail in days after expiry with whether it was bought, and the claims conditions as written; the incident with the date it occurred, the date a claim was made against the insured for a claims-made policy and its description; the filings with the dates notice was given and proof of loss was filed; and optionally the date the deadlines are read on. The signed report gives the policy, the incident, the trigger date against the policy period, the incident against the retroactive date and a claim after expiry against the tail with the day it ends, the notice deadline counted from the incident date with the day notice was given, the days late or the days left, and the proof-of-loss deadline the same way, and counts them, and names a missed deadline: a trigger date outside the policy period, an incident before the retroactive date, a claim made after the tail ends or with no tail bought, notice given after its deadline and proof of loss filed after its deadline; then a claim timely only by a bought tail and a notice or proof deadline that falls within 7 days of the date read on, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No trigger, no policy period, no incident date, no claim date or retroactive date for a claims-made policy, no record of whether a needed tail was bought, no notice or proof period, or no filing date and no date to read on leaves the deadlines unverified. This reads one incident against the claims deadlines of the policy behind it: a counterparty’s policy excerpt read as diligence evidence is wever_insurance-evidence-check, every date and obligation in a document is wever_deadline-check and an agent’s open commitments against their deadlines are wever_commitment-deadline-check. Verdict insurance_claims_deadline_missed, insurance_claims_partial, insurance_claims_unverified or insurance_claims_timely. POST /api/insurance-claims-deadline-check. Reads the insurance records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, claim filing, coverage binding or external write. Agent Insurance reads an insurance policy after the fact, from the subject’s own records: the coverage against the insured activity, the exclusions against the activity and its parts, the limits against the stated exposure, the deductible against what the buyer was told, the claims deadlines against an incident, a certificate against the policy it was issued from, incident notice under the policy and a renewal against the expiring policy. Beside it, wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt as diligence evidence and reports what that material establishes against required coverages, limits and a work window, while an insurance check reads the subject’s own policy against a stated need, an incident or a certificate issued from it; wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while an insurance check reads an insurance policy; and wever_risk-downside-check reads a planned action’s downside before it is taken, while an insurance check reads the policy behind it after the fact. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-insurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-insurance/.

as_of.description: The date the deadlines are read on, for a notice or proof not yet given, such as 2026-12-02.

notice_given_on.description: The date notice was given, such as 2026-12-02.

proof_filed_on.description: The date proof of loss was filed, such as 2026-12-02.

claim_made_on.description: The date a claim was made against the insured, for a claims-made policy, such as 2026-12-02.

occurred_on.description: The date of the incident, such as 2026-12-02.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

effective.description: The date the policy takes effect, such as 2026-12-02.

expires.description: The date the policy expires, such as 2026-12-02.

extended_reporting_days.description: The extended reporting period or tail, in days after expiry, for a claims-made policy.

notice_days.description: Days from the incident by which notice must be given.

proof_counted_from.description: Whether the proof-of-loss days count from the incident or the notice; the incident when left out.

proof_of_loss_days.description: Days by which proof of loss must be filed.

retroactive_date.description: The retroactive date, for a claims-made policy, such as 2026-12-02.

tail_purchased.description: Whether the extended reporting period was bought.

trigger.description: Whether the policy responds to occurrences in the period or claims made in the period.
